To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Illinois Freedom of Information Act., I hereby request the following records:

To the DuPage County Sheriff’s Office’s Records Custodian:

VIDIZMO has published a case study describing the DuPage County Sheriff’s Office’s use of its Digital Evidence Management System.

Therefore, I hereby request the following records:

1) All instructional materials, presentations and presentation materials (including recorded video and audio, PowerPoint files, prepared remarks, and slides), and other guidance on the use of VIDIZMO, EnterpriseTube, Digital Evidence Management System (DEMS), Redactor, Intelligence Hub / AI Intelligence Hub, and/or AI Live Insight. This includes A) any notes taken during meetings that discussed the use of VIDIZMO or these products, B) any explanations (whether internally or externally generated) of how VIDIZMO or these products work, and C) any other documents used to explain their use, including internal documentation, public relations materials, and executive summaries.

2) A copy of any privacy impact assessments, use policies, technical explainers or assessments, standard operating procedures, data retention policies, legal opinions or assessments, warranties, non-disclosure agreements, contracts, liability waivers, insurance agreements, Requests for Proposals, Responses to Requests for Proposals, Memorandums of Understanding, Letters of Interest, usage policies, or informal agreements concerning VIDIZMO or its products, including agreements between this office and VIDIZMO or its resellers.

3) A copy of any funding opportunity announcements, grant applications and grantor status/progress reports, reports to legislative bodies, or annual reports that mention VIDIZMO or its products, as well as audit records, including but not limited to security audits of the software, misuse reports, and reports to oversight bodies.

4) Any digital communications (including but not limited to emails and text messages), as well as documents (including but not limited to PDFs, word processing files, spreadsheets, and slide documents), that mention VIDIZMO, or communications sent to or from email addresses with the @vidizmo.com or @vidizmo.ai domains.

5) Any case reports in which VIDIZMO or its products were used.

6) Any digital communications (including but not limited to emails and text messages) with VIDIZMO representatives.

7) Any digital communications, presentations, or contracts involving employees of other law enforcement or government agencies concerning VIDIZMO or its products.

Please also include any miscellaneous documents that facilitate this office’s relationship with VIDIZMO or its products that do not fall neatly into the above categories. Please search for records dated between January 1, 2023, and the date this request is processed.

The requested documents will be used in the course of reporting for 404 Media, an independent technology journalism website: https://www.404media.co/

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Jason Koebler

title: Obama Presidential Library: NSC Coordination and Oversight Records Regarding "Virtual Embassy Tehran" and the USAdarFarsi Farsi-Language Social Media Outreach (2011)

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

NSC Coordination and Oversight Records Regarding "Virtual Embassy Tehran" and the USAdarFarsi Farsi-Language Social Media Outreach (2011)

I. Request Description & Scope

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act (5 U.S.C. § 552), I request access to and copies of historical records maintained by the Barack Obama Presidential Library within the presidential materials of the National Security Council (NSC) concerning the NSC's role in the planning, interagency coordination, and rollout of:

1. "Virtual Embassy Tehran" (iran.usembassy.gov / persian.iran.usembassy.gov), launched December 2011; and
2. The associated Farsi-language digital outreach platforms operated under the @USAdarFarsi name — the USAdarFarsi Twitter/X account, Facebook page, and any related Google+ or YouTube presence established in 2011.

Specifically, I request:

A. Policy & Action Memoranda: All Action Memorandums, Information Memorandums, Policy Guidance Memos, and Decision Memos created, received, or routed by the NSC Directorate for Iran and Persian Gulf Affairs (and/or broader Middle East Directorates) concerning the strategy, interagency approval, and public launch of Virtual Embassy Tehran and the USAdarFarsi social media accounts.

B. Interagency Coordination Records: All interagency cables, background papers, briefing materials, and meeting summaries maintained in NSC files regarding White House-level review or approval of State Department plans to establish a direct Farsi-language digital diplomatic presence aimed at Iranian audiences, January 1, 2011 – December 31, 2012.

C. Electronic Mail Communications: All emails sent, received, or copied (CC/BCC) by NSC Senior Directors, Directors, or Special Assistants for Iran and Persian Gulf Affairs containing any of the following search terms:

   - "Virtual Embassy"
   - "Tehran Embassy" AND ("virtual" OR "digital")
   - "USAdarFarsi" OR "@USAdarFarsi"
   - "iran.usembassy.gov" OR "persian.iran.usembassy.gov"

II. Targeted Record Collections & Key Custodians

To assist NARA staff in conducting an efficient search, I request that searches be prioritized within the following Presidential record collections:

- Collection: National Security Council (NSC) Records Management / Presidential Committee Materials.
- Directorate: NSC Directorate for Iran and Persian Gulf Affairs / Near East and South Asia Affairs.
- Key Officials/Custodians (including predecessor/successor roles):
  - Senior Directors for Central Region / Iran (e.g., Dennis Ross, Puneet Talwar)
  - NSC Directors for Iranian Affairs / Gulf States (2011–2012)
  - Deputy National Security Advisor for Strategic Communications (Ben Rhodes)

Note: I understand the underlying accounts were operated by the Department of State; this request is limited to NSC's oversight, coordination, and awareness of the initiative as reflected in Presidential records, not to State's own operational files.

III. Declassification of Withheld Material

I do not request that this submission be processed concurrently as a Mandatory Declassification Review (MDR) request, as I understand NARA requires an election between FOIA and MDR where the same records are at issue (36 C.F.R. § 1260.72(d)), and that MDR requires identification of specific classified material with reasonable particularity (36 C.F.R. § 1260.70(d)) — a level of specificity not yet possible for records I have not seen.

Instead, I request that if any responsive records are withheld in whole or in part under FOIA Exemption 1 (5 U.S.C. § 552(b)(1)), NARA provide a withholding log (Vaughn index) sufficiently detailed to identify each such document by date, type, and general subject. I reserve the right to submit a separate, follow-on MDR request under Section 3.5 of E.O. 13526 for the specific documents identified in that log.

IV. Fee Category

I am requesting these records as a news media requester in connection with research and reporting for MuckRock News. I authorize processing fees up to $25.00; please notify me before incurring any costs above this threshold.

V. Segregability & Response Period

As required by FOIA regulations, if any portion of a requested document is exempt from disclosure, please release all reasonably segregable non-exempt portions, and cite the specific exemption(s) claimed for any material withheld in full.

Thank you for your assistance with this historical inquiry. I look forward to your acknowledgment letter.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Robert Delaware
